verdict.rationale: Asana offers rule-based automation, webhooks/API, AI Studio no-code automations, and AI Teammates described as handling 'complex, coordination-heavy work' with shared memory and governance — these are generic building blocks that could be configured to triage/prioritize tasks, but no evidence explicitly documents a bug-triage or prioritization use case or template. Missing for 10: a concrete documented workflow or template showing AI classifying/prioritizing incoming bugs or tasks, independent/hands-on validation of such a workflow.
